inputs.original_text: This was never just a paperwork mix-up. ICE lawyers relied on a document that gave them no authority to arrest people leaving immigration court, and thousands were arrested anyway. The “mistake” story protects the machinery: people seeking legal status are being turned into targets, while institutions hide behind legal language to make the workaround look legitimate. The lawsuit is beginning to expose how deliberate that arrangement appears to be.
inputs.modified_text: Don’t let them sell this as a paperwork mistake. ICE lawyers used a document that gave them no authority to arrest people leaving immigration court, yet thousands were arrested. That looks less like an accident than a workaround built to turn people seeking legal status into targets—and then use legal language to conceal who made it possible. The lawsuit is starting to expose how deliberate the arrangement may have been.
